text: Program Description 1. Teaching Objective​ Editor Notes: The Aeronautical Engineering (Aircraft Manufacturing) in SAU is set up to cultivate students with both theories and practice klnowledge of related field. To train the senior engineers who are able to make research, manufacture, develop and manage the aeronautical engineering is the main peupose of this program. Students will obtain not only the basic theory of society, humanities and natural science, but also the professional knowledge of aircraft manufacturing engineering. Upon completing their study, students can use the professional knowledge to analyze and solve problems in the process of aircraft production. 2. Course Structure ​ Editor Notes: We can see both main courses and laboratory courses of Aeronautical Engineering (Aircraft Manufacturing) among the four years. Main Course Name Credits Advanced Matheematics I 5.0 Advanced Mathmatics II 5.0 Theoretical Mechanics 5.0 Material Mechanics 4.5 Mechanism Analysis and Design 4.0 Aircraft Mechanical Systems 5.0 Aircraft CAD/CAM Lab 5.0 Courses arrangements and credits as well as Laboratory Courses in detail.>> 3. Career and Internship Editor Notes: Students can take internship in the companies under the university. Graduates can undertake the design, production, research and management applications in aerospace or other industrial sectors. There are three companies under the colleague can offers internship for students to work and study every year, offering students major in aeronautical engineering to take internship for 1 week every October. These companies are: Shenyang Liming Engine (Group) Co., Ltd. Shenyang Aircraft Engine Design Institute. Shenyang Aircraft Design and Research Institute. 4. Facilities Editor Notes: SAU owns a number of advanced labs and research centres. The college has been awarded with the National Natural Sciences Fund, Aeronautical Science Fund, Liaoning Province Science Fund, the National Defense Advanced Research topic etc. and 80 other new machine development topics, research spending have amounted to 15 million Yuan. The college has 22 laboratories, including Aircraft Design and synthesis lab, fatigue and vibration lab, mold/die lab, forming and fabrication characteristics lab etc. There are two key provincial laborites which can provide students more opportunities and facilities to make research in the colleague. 1) The stimulation and analysis of aircraft composites structure lab This lab is aimed to make application research of composite structure, mesoscale couple stress / strain gradient theory and micromechanics of composite laminated beams, plates I stress engineering theory etc. 2) Digital manufacturing and testing technology of aircraft lab This lab is aimed to make research of numerical stimulation of plastic forming process, mechanical analytic theory of titanium alloy heating forming, technology of aircraft structure parts and mechanical endurance test etc. 5. The college of Aerospace Engineering currently has 61 teaching and administrative staffs, including 8 professors, 28 associate professors 15 teachers with doctorate degree. There are 1120 undergraduate students, 47 engineering graduate students and 200 students studying a minor at the college. Teaching Subject: Aircraft Design Professor Li Shu Visiting Scholar in Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, University of California, Irvine, USA (2007-2008) Teaching Subject : Mechanical Vibrations and Rocket Propulsion Professor Wang Keming Visiting Scholar in Massachusetts Institute of Technology, USA (1995-1997) ​ Teaching Subject : Dynamics and Control of the Satellite Formations.​ Professor Xu Guangyan Doctor Degree in Nanyang Technological University(2002) 7. School Introduction​ Editor Notes: SAU is a key university in Liaoning Province. Shenyang Aerospace University has developed into an academic Centre, housing teaching buildings, research laboratories, a library which is both an architectural and cultural icon, a theatre building, sports arena, swimming center and student’s activity centers having 600,000 square meters of floor space and over 200, 000 square meters of landscaped gardens. Other services such as the school hospital, comfortable accommodations and a number of dining halls are also provided. Learn More>> 8. College of Aerospace Engineering Editor Notes: The College Aerospace Engineering has a very important place in SAU. Aeronautical Engineering is one of the important majors in the College of Aerospace Engineering, which was founded in November, 2003. The College of Aerospace Engineering has a first-level Aerospace Science master's degree and three second-level master's degree programs (Aerospace Manufacturing Engineering, Aircraft Design and Engineering Mechanics) Manufacturing Engineering is a characteristic discipline developed by the national defense science and industry committee and Liaoning Province and also the national defense science and industry committee period program with proper priority second-level discipline.
